description.subtitle: Adidas sweatshirt jacket from the Argentina - blue
description.intro: The Argentina adidas Originals jacket blends the legacy of football with current fashion. Inspired by the second team of the Argentine team, it brings character and authenticity to any urban look. Its iconic design recovers the classic essence of football with a modern approach, ideal for those who live the Argentine passion inside and outside the stadium.
key_benefits: Historical inspiration: Based on the colors of Argentina's second team.
Interlock fabric: Soft touch and resistant structure for daily use.
Classic cut: Comfortable and versatile fit.
Full Zipper: Practical and functional fit.
Logo Trefoil y escudo AFA: Identidad vintage con ADN futbolero.
